_help: Copy this file to settings.json and edit that copy; settings.json is git-ignored, so updates never overwrite it. Every key is optional: delete one to use the built-in default, which the monitor names at startup.

cache._persist_to_file_help: Set false to keep news, report, and 4chan baselines only until this process exits.

sound._wav_path_help: Set wav_path to null to use the normal Windows alert sound.
sound._loop_while_popup_open_help: Only applies to the dialog style below, which stays on screen until you click it. A toast is gone in seconds, so it plays the clip once.

notifications._style_help: toast for the sleek Windows notification that slides in and stays in Action Center, or dialog for the old blocking pop-up box. Monitor failures always use the dialog either way, because a toast can be swallowed by Focus Assist and a broken monitor must not go unseen.
notifications._icon_dir_help: A folder of sprite images shown on toasts. A market alert looks for the good's name, its short Dashboard label, or its numeric resource id (Copper.png, Copper.png, 2.png), then falls back to default.png. Other alerts look for messages/news/report/4chan. Case does not matter; png, jpg and gif work, ico does not. Set to null for no icons.
notifications._app_id_help: Leave null to file toasts under Windows PowerShell, which needs no setup but heads the toast with PowerShell's name and icon. Set it to a Start Menu shortcut's AppUserModelID to have toasts read CLOP monitor instead.

reports._ignore_help: Each entry below is one thing you can silence. Tick is the whole two-hourly tick report: internally the monitor removes all of its routine bookkeeping but still alerts on warnings inside that tick. Action: matches the recipe name and silences that completed action as one report, including its spent/paid/gained lines. The remaining entries are advanced per-line patterns for standalone report families. Matching ignores case; % stands for any run of characters. An entry starting with # is switched off: delete the # to switch it on.
ignore: You have created the military force
reports._actions_help: Action selectors use the actual recipe name from the game. 'Action: Build %' covers all 38 building, weapon and armour recipes whose names begin Build. Exact examples show how to silence only Burn Oil or only Distribute Pies. You can use any other name from the Actions page, or a family such as 'Action: Upgrade %', 'Action: Ship %', 'Action: Dig %', 'Action: Plow %', 'Action: Manufacture %', 'Action: Smuggle %' or 'Action: Distribute %'.
reports._tick_help: Tick is deliberately one option because cron/frequent.php writes one tick report. It covers the wrapper, production and consumption, relation and satisfaction effects, caps, government/economy/military upkeep, siphons, empire jealousy and environment repair. A tick that lost a force, starved a building, caused environmental damage, contained combat or triggered a revolt still alerts with only those warning lines.
reports._trade_help: 'You bought ...' and 'You sold ...' are each written to BOTH sides of a trade, with identical wording, so the monitor cannot tell which side you were. On marketplace.php 'You bought' goes to whoever clicked buy and 'You sold' goes to the seller whose listing was taken; on buyermarketplace.php it is the other way round. So the shipped 'You bought' pattern silences your own purchases AND a stranger filling your standing buy order. No 'You sold' pattern ships, because switching it on would also silence somebody buying from your standing sell order, which is usually the news you wanted. Add one yourself if you trade often enough that you would rather not hear about it.
reports._omissions_help: Three routine-looking families deliberately have NO pattern. 'You received % %.' is left out because the deal you accepted and a deal somebody else accepted read alike apart from the words 'as part of your deal', so any pattern short enough to cover the first covers the second, and the second is somebody acting on you. The eighteen Major Action lines ('Government changed to %', 'Economy changed to %', 'Nation name changed from % to %') are left out because you take one perhaps twice a year and seeing it confirmed is the point. 'You lose % sat for having an empire of % nations.' is left out because it is a standing penalty worth watching, not bookkeeping.

market._goods_help: A good whose key starts with # is switched off: delete the # to watch that good's buyer's market, and the monitor will alert every poll while a matching order is pending and you have stock above its reserve.
market._reserve_help: reserve must be the string none, qty, or ticks. none still requires Qty above 0. qty requires current Qty minus reserve_amount to be above 0. ticks requires the current Ticks-Worth to be above reserve_amount. reserve_amount must be a non-negative whole number. N/A ticks count as never running out, NONE as less than one tick; both still require positive Qty.
market._overrides_help: friends alerts on buyers on your friends list (blue in game); alliance alerts on buyers in your alliance (green in game); a buyer who is both satisfies either. always and never override both. IMPORTANT: they match the NATION name exactly as it appears in the Buyer column of the marketplace, NOT the player's username - the two are unrelated in this game, so a player called Lacera Viscera may play a nation called Fish Bucket, and you must write the nation. Matching works like reports.ignore: case-insensitive, anywhere in the name, % standing for any run of characters. never beats always, and always beats both friends and alliance. An always or never entry starting with # is switched off too. Note friends and alliance cover every nation a player owns, while always and never name one nation each.

fourchan._thread_url_help: Set thread_url to a thread you want watched, for example https://boards.4chan.org/mlp/thread/43454282/clop-financial-crisis-edition. Leave it null to disable thread monitoring; threads archive, so a URL left here goes stale.
